description: This file defines a Java interface 'CurrencyReadPlatformService' for accessing currency data within the Fineract project. It declares methods for retrieving allowed currencies, all platform currencies, and specific currency data by code.

classes.name: CurrencyReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for currency retrieval operations in the monetary service layer.

methods.name: retrieveAllowedCurrencies
methods.description: Returns a list of currencies that are permitted within the platform.

methods.name: retrieveAllPlatformCurrencies
methods.description: Returns a list of all currencies supported by the platform.

methods.name: retrieveCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves currency data for a specific currency identified by its code.
